verdict.rationale: Bolt runs generated apps in an in-browser environment where the AI controls the filesystem, Node server, terminal and console (bolt-gh-1, bolt-gh-2), and production deployment is a separate step ('Deploy to production from chat', bolt-gh-3). That implies a dev/preview sandbox, but nothing documents isolating test data from production databases (Bolt Database/Supabase). One hands-on report also describes the agent making unauthorized changes that broke a launched app's payments (bolt-comm-7). Missing for 10: documented separate dev/staging vs production databases or environments, explicit guarantees that preview/testing never touches live data, and independent corroboration of safe sandboxed testing.
